security.title: You're in control.
security.s1: Threads passwords are never saved. Login is only via official Meta OAuth.
security.s2: Your analytics and style documents are isolated from other users.
security.s3: Text processed by AI is sent to model providers (Gemini/Groq). Details in the Privacy Policy.
security.s4: Turn off automation or disconnect anytime via the Kill Switch.

pricing.title: Start from here.
pricing.desc: Choose a plan that fits. We are constantly improving based on your feedback.

pricing.note: 1 credit = 1 AI action (generate, AI reply, repurpose, advanced analysis). Reply templates and Quick Score are free. Own API key is only available in paid plans.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Ixiera is still in early access, so each account is added manually and needs approval first. You'll be notified via email.
faq.a2: There's a 7-day trial with 20 free credits, no upfront payment. After that, a 30-day plan with no auto-renew.
faq.a3: One credit is used for one AI action. Reply templates and Quick Score don't use credits.
faq.q4: Will it post without my permission?
faq.a4: No, unless you enable it. Replies have two modes: Manual Review and Full Auto. Kill Switch turns everything off anytime.
faq.a5: The reply limit per hour can be set to comply with Meta API policies. The final decision is Meta's, so start with a low limit.
faq.a6: Set the "Tone Prompt" in Settings, AI is directed to be polite, brief, and match your style.
faq.q7: How is this different from a regular scheduler?
faq.a7: A scheduler only schedules. Ixiera learns from your account data to decide what, when, and how you post.
faq.a8: Text processed by AI is sent to model providers (Gemini/Groq) to generate drafts and replies. Details in the Privacy Policy.
faq.q9: Do I need to be technical?
